name: How long does a typical pipe rerouting project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical pipe rerouting project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a pipe rerouting project varies significantly based on the scope, the accessibility of the pipes, and the complexity of the new layout. A small reroute for a single fixture might take a day, while a whole-house repiping with rerouting could take several days to over a week. Process clarity often involves understanding that access to walls, floors, or ceilings will be needed, and this preparation work can influence the overall timeline, requiring temporary disruptions to water service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on scope and complexity, ranging from a day for minor reroutes to over a week for whole-house projects.
